sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Michael Bogle was released from HMP Wandsworth on 1 October under the government's early release scheme. Within four days, he stole more than £100 worth of detergent from north London supermarkets. He was arrested on Tuesday, admitted the offences on Wednesday, and received an eight-month sentence for breaching a suspended sentence.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: A senior police officer raised concerns that releasing high-risk offenders transfers pressure onto policing and puts communities at risk. The Ministry of Justice defended the scheme, stating it was necessary because the prison system was on the brink of collapse.
